```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sf))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

gpkg <- file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/tarragones-boundaries-icgc-20260120.gpkg")
mun <- sf::st_read(gpkg, layer = "municipalities_250k", quiet = TRUE)

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

## Unió per codi municipal: cal igualar formats.
mun$CODIMUNI <- as.character(mun$CODIMUNI)
indicators$mun_code <- as.character(indicators$mun_code)
indicators$mun_code <- ifelse(nchar(indicators$mun_code) == 5, paste0("0", indicators$mun_code), indicators$mun_code)

d <- merge(mun, indicators, by.x = "CODIMUNI", by.y = "mun_code", all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 22, any(!is.na(d$housing_non_main)))

## Exemple problemàtic: recompte absolut en coropleta, paleta automàtica i absències amagades.
fig <- ggplot(d) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = housing_non_main), color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Blues",
    direction = 1,
    na.value = "#d8dde2",
    name = "Habitatges no\nprincipals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Habitatge no principal als municipis del Tarragonès",
    subtitle = "Recompte absolut, 2021: el mapa convida a llegir la mida de l'àrea com si fos intensitat",
    caption = "Exemple didàctic: recomte absolut en coropleta, llegenda automàtica i absències representades amb una classe gris." 
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, color = "#17202a"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b", size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/thematic-cartography/choropleth-absolute-counts-bad-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 7, height = 7.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```
